fixture: real New campaign from the main menu, Viridia, The Clearing (no debug fixture)
expected: The first half hour plays with real input: menu, wake-up, power, embryo bank, star map, approach, orbit, descent, surface (scanner, drone, samples, relay, hazard), ascent, pause/save/main menu/continue, landing, Ark descent, first colony minutes; no softlock, no stale or missing prompts, no lost input.

fixed.what: Embryo bank and star map objectives were never shown: restore_power switches the campaign to VOYAGE and both were ARK-phase objectives, so the HUD jumped from 'Restore emergency power' to 'Compare the candidates'.
fixed.check: unit test_objective_chain_after_power; final run objectives in log.jsonl

fixed.what: 'Compare the candidates' only completed with a probe although its own text says 'or compare the known worlds'.
fixed.fix: Opening the Comparison tab marks candidates_compared; hint rewritten

fixed.what: Skipped steps pointed back: travelling without probing left 'Compare the candidates' (waypoint: star map) as the objective in orbit.
fixed.fix: objectives superseded_by (voyage steps -> obj_travel, orbital scan -> obj_expedition), honoured by ObjectiveService.current

fixed.what: Orbital scan hint said it costs fuel; it costs one day.
Ship prompt stale after closing the coupling ('[E] Connect'), and gone after closing a terminal panel while still at the console.
fixed.fix: ship_scene refreshes the prompt on state change and on panel close

fixed.what: Surface prompt stale after a sample or the relay ('[E] Take sample / Hold E for 8 seconds').
fixed.fix: surface_scene rewrites the prompt when the target's lock changes

fixed.what: Touchdown offered '[E] Return to the lander' (ends the expedition) as the very first prompt.
fixed.fix: The lander is off the interact layer until the captain is 8 m off the pad or has a sample

fixed.what: Drone reserve wasted: called on a 97 % suit it added 3 %.
fixed.fix: First press on a nearly full suit warns, a second press within 5 s calls the pod

fixed.what: Descent controls line unreadable ('[W / Up][S / Down] speed ...' at 15 px).
fixed.fix: One key per action like the approach flight, 18 px, wider

fixed.what: Colony hint 'Press B for colony mode': B leaves the build view for captain mode.
fixed.fix: Hint points at the build bar (+ Danish)

fixed.what: Colony: Esc with a building ghost opened the pause menu, although the ghost tip says '[Right click/Esc] cancel'.
fixed.fix: colony_scene._input cancels the ghost on the pause action

fixed.what: Colony: the ghost tip panel swallowed clicks on the ground behind it (placing near the bottom of the screen did nothing).
fixed.check: smoke colony_ghost_tip_lets_clicks_through; driver built care_center at (-11, 28)

fixed.what: Colony opens paused with no word about it: placed buildings never progress until time runs.
fixed.fix: First placement while paused shows a toast (Space or play 1x) (+ Danish)

fixed.what: Continue/Load in orbit put the captain in the cryo bay, 50 m from the bridge where the voyage stands.
fixed.fix: Loaded in orbit (power on, wake-up done, no spawn param): start at the orbit terminal

fixed.what: Colony ghost polled the OS cursor: froze when the window lost focus and could not follow scripted input.
fixed.fix: Ghost follows the pointer's input events (same behaviour for players)

open.what: scene_landing_commit line 1 'Before you confirm: the Ark cannot lift off again ...' plays after the confirm, during the Ark descent. It has generated voice (scene_landing_commit_01), so the owner should re-record it or move the scene; a text-only change would desync the voice.

No event or decision in the first colony minutes: every event needs population >= 1 and day >= 220, and the first cohort needs 30 days of food (greenhouse), the habitat filter module on Viridia and more housing (blockers are listed on the care center card). Design/balance call.
The expedition is short for a sprinting player (65 s, suit 93 % at the end; the bible aims at 6-10 minutes). Balance.
Route sign 'Through the hollow' is clipped by terrain in the spore hollow (Label3D depth). Cosmetic.
Not exercised: gamepad, touch, reduced motion, a manual-only descent to touchdown, risky voyages, other planets.
